purpose: Production mapping from curriculum category to topic to lesson content and reusable assets.

coverageSemantics.coverage: Tracks the availability of reusable visual assets. It does not prove that every vocabulary item, sentence pattern, dialogue, useful note, or practice requirement from the lesson is implemented.
coverageSemantics.lessonContract: The required completeness record for a lesson. It must trace every required teaching element to a child-facing scene, word, useful note, or practice item before the lesson can be marked content-complete.
